duas.title: Before Eating
duas.translation: In the name of Allah and with the blessings of Allah.

duas.title: After Eating
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنَا وَسَقَانَا وَجَعَلَنَا مُسْلِمِينَ
duas.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi at'amana wa saqana wa ja'alna Muslimeen
duas.translation: Praise be to Allah who has fed us and given us drink and made us Muslims.

duas.title: Before Sleeping
duas.translation: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.

duas.title: Upon Waking Up
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
duas.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi ahyana ba'da ma amatana wa ilayhin-nushoor
duas.translation: All praise is for Allah who gave us life after having taken it from us, and unto Him is the resurrection.

duas.title: Entering the Home
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَلَجْنَا، وَبِسْمِ اللَّهِ خَرَجْنَا، وَعَلَى اللَّهِ رَبِّنَا تَوَكَّلْنَا
duas.transliteration: Bismillahi walajna, wa bismillahi kharajna, wa 'ala Allahi Rabbina tawakkalna
duas.translation: In the name of Allah we enter and in the name of Allah we leave, and upon our Lord we place our trust.

duas.title: Leaving the Home
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ
duas.transliteration: Bismillahi tawakkaltu 'alal-lahi la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah
duas.translation: In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah. There is no power and no strength except with Allah.

duas.title: Entering the Toilet
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخُبُثِ وَالْخَبَائِثِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-khubuthi wal-khaba'ith
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from evil and impure things.

duas.title: When Wearing New Clothes
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ كَسَوْتَنِيهِ أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِهِ وَخَيْرِ مَا صُنِعَ لَهُ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma lakal-hamdu anta kasawtaneehi, as'aluka min khayrihi wa khayri ma suni'a lah
duas.translation: O Allah, for You is all praise, You have clothed me with it. I ask You for its good and the good for which it was made.
